subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should OpenClaw adopt process-local Feishu cancellation for every single-agent and broadcast run bound to a recalled or exact-source-missing message?
rationale: Current and shipped behavior do not define recall as cancellation, and the canonical issue explicitly leaves shared-versus-channel-local lifecycle semantics to maintainers; implementation quality cannot decide that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor scoped Feishu cancellation
options.body: Reopen and land the tested plugin-local behavior while leaving shared cross-channel and multi-process semantics to the canonical issue.

options.title: Sponsor explicit-event-only cancellation
options.body: Reopen after removing the 231003 fallback so only im.message.recalled_v1 cancels work.

options.title: Wait for shared lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this PR closed until maintainers define one cross-channel source-message lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped Feishu cancellation
recommendation.body: Reopen and land the tested plugin-local behavior while leaving shared cross-channel and multi-process semantics to the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent merged history across the Feishu inbound, dispatch, dedupe, and reply-delivery boundaries affected by this choice.
